_README: EVERY NUMBER HERE IS A PLACEHOLDER. Verify each one on the day of the
hackathon and set verified=true with the URL you checked. Judges will
discount a tokenomics study built on prices nobody sourced.
Units: gpu_hourly_usd is per single GPU per hour. Cloud prices are USD

gpu_rental._note: What one GPU-hour of the LaunchPad-class hardware costs you if you had to rent it. Use on-demand list price for the headline number and a reserved/committed rate for the sensitivity analysis.

H100-NVL-94GB.source: https://gpus.io/en/gpus/h100nvl - median of listed providers, checked 2026-09-17; range 2.91-3.19

owned_hardware._note: Alternative to renting: amortize a bought box. This is the number a Swiss enterprise with a data-residency requirement actually cares about, and it usually wins at high volume.

cloud_apis._note: Comparison set. Mix (a) a frontier API, (b) an open-weights model served by a token vendor, and (c) Apertus served by someone else if such an endpoint exists. Fill in real numbers on the day.

frontier-api-tier1.notes: closed weights, no data residency guarantee

swisscom-apertus-v1.5-70b.notes: THE comparator: same model, same weights, hosted. Free for hackathon participants, so there is no published per-token price - find Swisscom's commercial rate, or state plainly that you are comparing against a free tier and use the measured throughput at their 5 req/s cap as the basis. Limits: 5 req/s, 10M input / 2.5M output budget, 60-minute bearer.

multimodal._note: Apertus 1.5 takes image and audio input. Audio is 40 tokens per second, so one minute of speech = 2400 input tokens. Use this to quote cost per minute of audio and compare against dedicated speech APIs - a cost axis a text-only study cannot reach.

assumptions._utilization_note: Fraction of wall-clock the self-hosted GPU is actually serving at the benchmarked operating point. Real enterprise traffic is diurnal; 100% is a lie and judges know it. Run the sensitivity sweep at 20/45/80.
assumptions._cloud_egress_note: Add if your comparator charges for data transfer.
